math_bound: Both modes ingest exactly the same 12 immutable 4000-row JSONEachRow batches and hold 48000 sample points and 10000 distinct series per fresh process. Measure /proc process-tree utime+stime before and after write (MERGES STOPPED), then before START MERGES through final OPTIMIZE. A/A drift must be <=25% separately for CPU and wall for each measured interval. CPU ticks are 10ms; 15ms difference in 225-240ms writes is too small for a general performance claim.
method: One ubuntu24 GitHub runner, fresh process and separate data dir per A0 LC/B1 RAW/B2 RAW/A3 LC phase. Include both clickhouse watchdog parent and child worker PIDs via /proc/PID/task/PID/children; CPU of parent alone was 0 in invalid run 41623203578. Fixed fixture SHA and native PromQL avg-by(scope) independent oracle, 48k sample points per phase, 12 QueryFinish and 5 MergeParts each. Explicit merges controlled after STOP MERGES, no concurrent native reads. No perf instrumentation sampling overhead.
limitations: CPU deltas only 0.10-0.24s with 10ms clock resolution; 6.3% CPU and 9.1% merge deltas require longer workload replication before a performance recommendation.
Single GitHub runner ABBA, no concurrent native reads or natural background merge arrival; synthetic 10000 IDs not production node turnover.
/proc process tree CPU covers clickhouse parent+child, not remote EBS/network cost; per-process write_bytes includes log/writeback and is not exact storage allocation.
Both modes use stock O1 glibc laboratory binary; pending jemalloc optimized build is not represented.
negative_experiment: CI 41623203578 had 4/4 phase correctness, but was INVALID for CPU because it measured only clickhouse watchdog parent PID and rejected valid float differences of about 1e-13 via bitwise equality. CI 41623149595 failed workflow preflight due artifact path typo. Neither run can support CPU rankings.

next_action.step: Amplify same-runner CPU from 12 to 96 chronological small batches per phase under identical stock O1, reusing stable/rotating fixture generator and exact native mean oracle over full 4h window; require >=1s CPU per measured interval or classify as insufficient resolution. Preserve CPU/wall and physical byte ratios; source/fixture immutable SHA; no production change or cancel.
next_action.stop_condition: Reject if native output/physical samples mismatch, process tree CPU zero/unstable, A/A drift >25%, unexpected OOM or unbounded parts. Do not call candidate faster from one run.
